content: Yoane misa-lowac weibong
Dameng iwa Yesule siducti ngictau Herode, yele hedecka haume
ye ngagelu bole-ngicfocine edocebawec, “Yoane misa-lowacti homackacni gboliye fangkelu gagac, ye Yesu. Ilec ailu tapili facnogacte pasi damuineholec balu gagac.”

I yangucte, Herodedi Yesule siduc mi ngagelu esecne gbaine Filipte ngigac Herodias ye hise balu gawec. Aibaba yogolec ailu Yoanedi Herode yanguc edowec, “Ga ngigac yogo balu yeholec gagic, yogo yefe monic mi fagac.” Inguc mime Herodedi Yoane balu hefelu muc-macka lolu
wehomanogale ngagesiwec. Aime ngic-ngigac yenge ye Wapongte siduc-mimi ngic, inguc ngageibongte ailu hangocebawec.
Aime Herodele fike-fike dameng kwesime, ngic-ngigac yenge yela habu balu ngiyeebongka Herodias aduinedi yengele hewacka fangkelu gee wewec. Weme Herodedi ngani-angac aicnolu
Wapongte wacka yowa sanangkenale yanguc mipangkewec, aduine ye wiyac monicte aicnome yogo nalic lacnodaicte.
Mipangkeme adu ye nenggacinedi ngage-ngage lacnome Herode yanguc edowec, “Ga Yoane misa-lowacte hodoc welockebong pelewa lolu bawelelu neledamec.”
Inguc mime ngictaudi ngagelu kwele-umac ngagewec. Ailu ngic ngiyeibong, yengele haicka yowa biyac mime sanangkewec. Ilec ailu aduinele yowa ngagewec, Yoanele hodoc yogo lacnonale mipangkelu
hudu-baba ngic monic saleme lelu Yoane muc-macka ngiyewec, ye ubeine welockewec.
Welockelu hodocine pelewa lolu bawelelu aduine lacnome adudi nenggacinela balewec.
Aime Yoane mic-tengtengfocine yenge hikelu kponggbongine bahikelu longkeibong. Longkebong motome hikelu Yesu siduc yogo edoibong.
Nosing gumecebawec

Edobong Yesu ye siduc yogo ngagelu mac-himong yogo hegilelu gombawa felu mic-tengtengfocine yengeholec mac-himong monic ngic mikacka, iwa yeicnac ganale hikewec. Aime ngic-ngigac habutowadi yenge yogo biyac ngagelu taonngineng hegilelu hige-yefe balaibelu hikeibong.
Hikebong Yesu ye gombawacni walu ngic-ngigac habutowa inguc nganicebalu kweleine sowaleme ngic-ngigac hucnginengkolec bamadicebawec.

Bamadicebalu gacgume mac aweleme mic-tengtengfocine yengi yela lelu yanguc miibong, “Himong yago ngic mikac, aime wenac haume mac biyac awelegac. Ilec ailu ga ngic-ngigac habutowa yago salecebang mac-aling gocna hikening. Yenge hikelu yengung nosing fuli banoc aining.”
Inguc mibong yedi yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: “Yenge hike-hikelesoc mi aigaing, ngenge ngengung nosing yelebong noning.”

content: Inguc mime yengi miibong, “Nonge bret 5 nga misa-sic yaeckang sugu balu gagabeleng.”
Inguc mibong yedi yanguc miwec,

Yesu ye inguc milu ngic-ngigac habutowa kpindingka wangiyeningte edocebawec. Edocebalu bret 5 ailu misa-sic yaeckang, yogo balu dongeine hilame honocmengka feme Wapong kwele-madic micnowec. Micnolu bret yogo bauckelu mic-tengtengfocine yeleme yengi balu ngic-ngigac habutowa yelebong noibong.
Aime yenge sasawadi nogebec ailu nosing tofaine notiwa aibong ngiyewec, yogo kpaduckebong haulu damba 12 wakewec.
Ngic-ngigac nosing noibong, yogo yengelacni ngic yengele dzalengineng yogo 5 taosen ngama ingucne. Nga ngigac adu-madec noibong, yengele dzalengineng yogo monic mi wafeibong.
Lifuc feina hikewec
Damba wakeme Yesu ye mic-tengtengfocine salecebame yenge gombawa felu misa lifuc nebocina molickelu hikeibong. Hikebong ye yeicnac galu ngic-ngigac habutowa locebame hikeyackeibong.
Hikeebongka ye milockenale kupicka feme mac deboleme yeicnac ngiyewec.
Ngiyeme yenge gombawa biyac lifuc hewacina hikeebongka gbelong sugucnedi yenge hikedaingtewa, yefe kwesilu dibongti gomba welu bafangkeme fec-wac aiwec.
Inguc aime mac biyac saenogale aiyemewa Yesu ye lifuc feina edela edela mic-tengtengfocine yengela hikewec.
Ye lifuc feina edela edela hikeme mic-tengtengfocine yenge nganilu yanguc miibong, “Ilucti welegac.” Inguc milu hangocebame aukweibong.
Aukwebong Yesudi ngagelu iwahac yanguc edocebawec,

content.text: Ngenge ngageboc mikac sanangne domadaing. Ngenge mi hangocngebana.”

content: Pita misa feina hikewec
Inguc mime Pitadi hefaliyelu miwec, “Sugucne, gageicne welegic ingucnehac, na misa feina edela edela gala fubele minelec.”
Inguc mime Yesudi miwec,
Inguc mime Pita ye gombawacni walu misa feina edela edela Yesula lewec.
Leemewa dibong gbelong sugucne weme nganilu hangockewec. Inguc aime misawa haunogale ailu hangockeme aukwelu miwec, “Sugucne, ga baficnunong.”
Inguc mime Yesu ye moleine biyac sungkelu Pitale mole balu bafangkelu yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga ngage-ngagesinggone kpisicnemac, ga omale ngageboc aigic?”

content: Inguc micnowec.
Micnome yeke gombawa feebocka iwahac gbelong miyac aiwec.
Aime gombawa ngiyeibong, yenge Yesu afeelu yanguc miibong, “Foinac, ga Wapongte Madec.”
Ngic-ngigac hucnginengkolec
Aime yenge lifuc falockelu Genesaret himongka hike sulumeibong.
Iwa hikebong himong yogolec ngic yengi Yesu biyac ngani-motolu yowa lobong hikeyackeme yenge ngic-ngigac hucnginengkolec yela bacebalu kwesiibong.
Kwesilu hucnginengkolec yenge ngakpi daleinele muc susucine sugu oiyaningte dogbac ailu micnoibong. Aime oiyaibong, yenge sasawadi madickeibong.

footnotes.text: Herodias ye Yoane homanale ngagewecte ailu hodocine nganilu ngagewec, Yoane ye homawec.
Grik yowawa yogolec fungine “Na gagabachac.” Yogo Wapongte wac monic, Wapongte angelodi Moses edowec.
